reason: A is the stronger proposal because it defines a narrower intervention and validity window, gives measurable outcomes against a room-temperature LPBF control, and provides a clearer falsification experiment with some relevant prior support. Its proposed grain refinement and strength gains are not securely justified—preheating may instead promote grain coarsening, and the precise percentage improvements are unsupported—but B is less specific, uncited, and relies on an equally questionable claim that enhanced diffusion during solidification will reduce segregation.
